metadata.title: Exact g-function flows from the staircase model

extraction_notes.note: Sections are opened by the paper's own \resection/\appsection macros, which latex_facts.py does not recognise (0 sections reported); `section` fields were assigned by source offset from those headings, and the appendix title (which contains \ref's) is given as 'A Proofs of equations'.

The labelled numcases blocks (lng0fodd ... lngb2even, g0bodd/g0beven) are not reported as equation facts, so their \ref's do not resolve; each numcases block was emitted as one claim node and the \ref edges to it were added by hand.
equation or claim: kept as claims nested in ClP7 because their parts are justified at different places (b1/b2 in Section 3, g0 in Section 4).
The boundary-condition dictionary (gident) is stated as found empirically and then explicitly assumed; emitted as a conjectural claim plus a separate assumption node rather than as a conjecture.

Cited facts about the staircase / interpolating TBAs stated in prose; typed theorem with origin external per the rule for cited results stated in full, though the source presents them as known physics results rather than theorems.

Much of Section 3-4 content is carried by commutative-diagram flow skeletons and figures (m=5 grid, flow cubes); the displayed diagrams are kept inside the claim/example statements and the figure-only content is not extracted.
The case (i)-(iii) discussions argue and conclude in running text; each was split into a prose proof (the reasoning) and a claim starting at the 'Thus/Translated ... the flow is' sentence.

The unnumbered display after 'the first three terms of (gmodd) therefore become' (\nonumber inside equation) is not a fact and stays inside PP9; figure captions and the 'This explains why the plots ... stabilise' commentary sentences are not nodes.
